items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College and I’m extremely pleased to have David Murray with me... [INTERVIEWEE] Well I’m pleased to be here, Monk

ctx.x: David was interviewed in Clinton, New York on September 18, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College and I’m extremely pleased to have David Murray with me for the Jazz Archive.
Well I’m pleased to be here, Monk, because this is where I want to be, with all the greats.
